approvers: Spouse/co-owner, my tax adviser, buyer's house bank
reason: A brand-new Belize shell with no money committed and no track record is not who I hand my life's work to. And 30% over three years from a buyer like that is a promise I can't collect on.
objection: Where is the money? A Belize company with no committed funding wants 100% of my firm and wants me to wait three years for part of it. I expect a higher price in cash at closing from someone else.
instead: List the business on nexxt-change and wait for a buyer who pays more cash at closing. Failing that, keep working or wind down and sell the equipment.
would_change_my_mind: Bank-verified proof of funds up front, a German or EU entity with real owners I can meet and a site visit, and at least 90% cash at closing, with my spouse agreeing.
